h1: Custom Gildan Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Gildan shirts in bulk for your team or event. Perfect Imprints offers embroidery and screen printing on Gildan tees and hoodies.
introHtml: Gildan shirts are a staple for bulk orders because they combine consistent sizing, durable cotton blends, and a wide range of styles from tees to hoodies. Whether you need uniform polos for your staff or soft-style t-shirts for a charity run, the Gildan lineup offers reliable printing surfaces for screen printing or embroidery. Choose from popular cuts like the Softstyle T-shirt for a premium feel or the Heavy Blend Hoodie for cooler weather.
heroAltText: Stack of custom Gildan shirts in various colors with screen printed logos
